title: Wynnhanced
description: A client-side & multiplayer-safe quality-of-life modpack for Wynncraft focused on immersion, clarity, performance, and security
body:
# Wynnhanced

A **client-side** & multiplayer-safe quality-of-life modpack for **Wynncraft** focused on immersion, clarity, performance, and security

### Visuals & Immersion
- **Wynntils included** for full Wynncraft feature integration
- **Voice acting** for (almost all) quests & NPC dialogue
- **Dynamic, toggleable weather** built specifically for Wynncraft
- **Higher-quality in-game music** using higher-fidelity audio & more accurate instrumentation
- **Distant Horizons & shader support** *(compatibility depends on shader pack)*
- Enhanced character & camera animations
- Improved particles, new environmental effects & dynamic lighting
- Carefully selected visual & quality of life mods to enhance atmosphere without introducing clutter
- Polished UI with cleaner layouts & smoother transitions
- Improved inventory interaction (scrolling, swapping, and GUI movement)
- Fancier & and better-structured tooltips with improved item readability

### Performance, Stability & Compatibility
- Reduced memory usage, improved loading times, FPS improvements, and stutter reduction
- Ensured compatibility with base Wynncraft game (Report bugs to the Discord server)
- Improved keybind handling and conflict reduction
- Numerous stability improvements & bug fixes

### Privacy & Multiplayer Security
- Client-side privacy improvements in public multiplayer environments
- Disables client-side signatures to reduce invasive chat-reporting behavior
- Disables client-sided telementary & analytical data from being sent to official Microsoft/Mojang servers, 3rd party multiplayer servers, and mods
- Improved connection stability with automatic recovery after disconnects
